test_title: PYST 17: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 08 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the meaningful and correctly spelt word from the options to fill in the blank.**

The song composed by the choir for the special programme was an ______ one.
solution:
The correct answer is **"imitated."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Imitated"** means **copied or replicated**, which makes sense in the context of a song being composed by a choir for a special programme. (नकल किया गया या दोहराया गया)

 
 
• **Example**: *The original world-making power, physis, degenerates into a prototype to be copied and **imitated**__.*
 
 
 
• The word is spelled correctly, unlike the other options, which are misspelled.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 

**Correct sentence**: *The song composed by the choir for the special programme was an __**imitated**__ one.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1, "imiteitted"**, is misspelled and not a real word.
 
• **Option 2, "emittated"**, is misspelled and not a real word.
 
• **Option 3, "eradicated"**, means to completely destroy or eliminate something, which doesn't make sense in the context of a song being composed. (किसी चीज़ को पूरी तरह से नष्ट या ख़त्म करना)

36:Tb70,

The correct answer is **"Philolegy."**
